```{r}

#############################################################################################################

# Replication-transcription orientation analysis using OK-seq data
# - Imports transcript annotations from a GTF file
# - Converts transcript coordinates into GRanges objects
# - Loads high-RFD OK-seq regions from multiple cell lines
# - Identifies positive and negative replication fork directionality domains
# - Determines transcription-replication orientation relationships
# - Classifies encounters as co-directional or head-on
# - Calculates orientation frequencies for each cell line
# - Generates a combined replication-directionality universe
# - Performs separate analyses for hPu- and hPy-associated regions
# - Computes orientation percentages across repeat categories
# - Produces barplots and faceted visualizations
# - Save all figures
#
# Requirements:
#   - GenomicRanges
#   - IRanges
#   - dplyr
#   - ggplot2
#   - tidyr

#############################################################################################################

# Packages installation CRAN + BIOCONDUCTOR
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "tidyr"
)

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "GenomicRanges"
)

# Utility function: install only missing CRAN packages
install_missing_cran <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    install.packages(
      missing,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
}

# Utility function: install only missing Bioconductor packages
install_missing_bioc <- function(pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      "BiocManager",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }

  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    BiocManager::install(
      missing,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Install missing packages
install_missing_cran(cran_pkgs)
install_missing_bioc(bioc_pkgs)

message("All required packages are installed.")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(tidyr)

#############################################################################################################

# Barplot Replication/transcription orientation (all hPu-hPy repeats)

# GTF file path : gencode.v19.annotation.gtf
gtf <- read.delim(
  "/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf/file/path",
  header = FALSE,
  comment.char = "#"
)

transcripts <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "transcript", ]

transcripts_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = transcripts$V1,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = transcripts$V4,
    end = transcripts$V5
  ),
  strand = transcripts$V7
)

# Function to read Okseq data
read_okseq <- function(file){

  df <- read.table(
    file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE
  )

  colnames(df) <- c(
    "chr",
    "start",
    "end",
    "RFD"
  )

  list(
    pos = GRanges(
      seqnames = df$chr[df$RFD > 0],
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = df$start[df$RFD > 0] + 1,
        end   = df$end[df$RFD > 0]
      )
    ),

    neg = GRanges(
      seqnames = df$chr[df$RFD < 0],
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = df$start[df$RFD < 0] + 1,
        end   = df$end[df$RFD < 0]
      )
    )
  )
}

# Import of Okseq bed files
cellline1  <- read_okseq("/cellline1/Okseq/high/RFD/bed/file/path")
cellline2  <- read_okseq("/cellline2/Okseq/high/RFD/bed/file/path")
cellline3  <- read_okseq("/cellline3/Okseq/high/RFD/bed/file/path")
cellline4 <- read_okseq("/cellline4/Okseq/high/RFD/bed/file/path")

# Function to analyze Okseq data
analyse_okseq <- function(name, pos_gr, neg_gr){
  ov_pos <- findOverlaps(
    transcripts_gr,
    pos_gr
  )

  ov_neg <- findOverlaps(
    transcripts_gr,
    neg_gr
  )

  tx_pos <- unique(queryHits(ov_pos))
  tx_neg <- unique(queryHits(ov_neg))

  strand_pos <- as.character(
    strand(transcripts_gr[tx_pos])
  )

  strand_neg <- as.character(
    strand(transcripts_gr[tx_neg])
  )

  codirectional <-
    sum(strand_pos == "+") +
    sum(strand_neg == "-")

  headon <-
    sum(strand_pos == "-") +
    sum(strand_neg == "+")

  total <- codirectional + headon

  data.frame(
    Sample = name,
    CoDirectional = codirectional,
    HeadOn = headon,
    CoDirectional_pct =
      100 * codirectional / total,
    HeadOn_pct =
      100 * headon / total
  )
}

res_cellline1 <- analyse_okseq(
  "cellline1",
  cellline1$pos,
  cellline1$neg
)

res_cellline2 <- analyse_okseq(
  "cellline2",
  cellline2$pos,
  cellline2$neg
)

res_cellline3 <- analyse_okseq(
  "cellline3",
  cellline3$pos,
  cellline3$neg
)

res_cellline4 <- analyse_okseq(
  "cellline4",
  cellline4$pos,
  cellline4$neg
)


# Univers OKseq
pos_univers <- reduce(c(
  cellline1$pos,
  cellline2$pos,
  cellline3$pos,
  cellline4$pos
))

neg_univers <- reduce(c(
  cellline1$neg,
  cellline2$neg,
  cellline3$neg,
  cellline4$neg
))

res_univers <- analyse_okseq(
  "Universe",
  pos_univers,
  neg_univers
)

summary_table <- rbind(
  res_cellline1,
  res_cellline2,
  res_cellline3,
  res_cellline4,
  res_univers
)

print(summary_table)


# Overlaps between transcription regions and Okseq data
ov_pos <- findOverlaps(
  transcripts_gr,
  pos_univers
)

ov_neg <- findOverlaps(
  transcripts_gr,
  neg_univers
)

tx_pos <- unique(queryHits(ov_pos))
tx_neg <- unique(queryHits(ov_neg))

strand_pos <- as.character(
  strand(transcripts_gr[tx_pos])
)

strand_neg <- as.character(
  strand(transcripts_gr[tx_neg])
)


# Co-directional / Head-on
codirectional <-
  sum(strand_pos == "+") +
  sum(strand_neg == "-")

headon <-
  sum(strand_pos == "-") +
  sum(strand_neg == "+")

res <- data.frame(
  Orientation = c(
    "Co-directional",
    "Head-on"
  ),
  Count = c(
    codirectional,
    headon
  )
)

res$Percent <- round(
  100 * res$Count / sum(res$Count),
  2
)

print(res)

# Plot preparation 
plot_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    Sample = summary_table$Sample,
    Orientation = "Co-directional",
    Percent = summary_table$CoDirectional_pct
  ),
  data.frame(
    Sample = summary_table$Sample,
    Orientation = "Head-on",
    Percent = summary_table$HeadOn_pct
  )
)

# Plot
p <- ggplot(plot_df,aes(x = Sample,y = Percent,fill = Orientation)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge",width = 0.7,color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Co-directional" = "lightpink2","Head-on" = "cadetblue3")) +
  ylim(0,100) +
  labs(x = "",y = "Percentage of transcripts") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,hjust = 1))

print(p)

# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "/output/plot/path",plot = p,width = 8,height = 4,units = "in")

#############################################################################################################

# Barplot Replication/transcription orientation hPu-hPy separated

# GTF file path : gencode.v19.annotation.gtf
gtf <- read.delim(
  "/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf/file/path",
  header = FALSE,
  comment.char = "#"
)

# Transcrits
transcripts <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "transcript",]

transcripts_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = transcripts$V1,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = transcripts$V4,
    end = transcripts$V5
  ),
  strand = transcripts$V7
)


# Function BED -> GRanges
load_gr <- function(file){

  df <- read.table(
    file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  GRanges(
    seqnames = df[,1],
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = df[,2] + 1,
      end = df[,3]
    )
  )
}

# Function Co-directional / Head-on
count_orientation <- function(tx_gr, ok_pos, ok_neg){
  ov_pos <- findOverlaps(tx_gr, ok_pos)
  ov_neg <- findOverlaps(tx_gr, ok_neg)

  tx_pos <- unique(queryHits(ov_pos))
  tx_neg <- unique(queryHits(ov_neg))

  strand_pos <- as.character(
    strand(tx_gr[tx_pos])
  )

  strand_neg <- as.character(
    strand(tx_gr[tx_neg])
  )

  codirectional <-
    sum(strand_pos == "+") +
    sum(strand_neg == "-")

  headon <-
    sum(strand_pos == "-") +
    sum(strand_neg == "+")

  data.frame(
    CoDirectional = codirectional,
    HeadOn = headon
  )
}

# Path with all the Okseq bed files (hPu-hPy separated and pos/neg separated)
bed_dir <- "/Okseq/high/RFD/bed/file/path"

files <- list.files(
  bed_dir,
  pattern = "\\.bed$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Analysis function
analyse_category <- function(category){

  pos_files <- files[
    grepl(
      paste0("_pos_", category, "\\.bed$"),
      files
    )
  ]

  neg_files <- files[
    grepl(
      paste0("_neg_", category, "\\.bed$"),
      files
    )
  ]

  sample_names <- gsub(
    paste0("_pos_", category, "\\.bed$"),
    "",
    basename(pos_files)
  )

  sample_names[
    sample_names ==
      "bed_file_patterns"
  ] <- "cellline"

  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_along(pos_files), function(i){
      sample_base <- gsub(
        paste0("_pos_", category, "\\.bed$"),
        "",
        basename(pos_files[i])
      )
      neg_file <- neg_files[
        gsub(
          paste0("_neg_", category, "\\.bed$"),
          "",
          basename(neg_files)
        ) == sample_base
      ]

      if(length(neg_file) == 0)
        return(NULL)

      pos_gr <- load_gr(pos_files[i])
      neg_gr <- load_gr(neg_file)

      tmp <- count_orientation(
        transcripts_gr,
        pos_gr,
        neg_gr
      )

      data.frame(
        Sample = sample_names[i],
        Category = category,
        tmp
      )
    })
  )
}

# hPu-hPy analysis 
res_hpu <- analyse_category("hpu")
res_hpy <- analyse_category("hpy")

summary_table <- rbind(
  res_hpu,
  res_hpy
)


# Percentage calculation 
summary_table$Total <-
  summary_table$CoDirectional +
  summary_table$HeadOn

summary_table$CoDirectional_pct <-
  round(
    100 *
      summary_table$CoDirectional /
      summary_table$Total,
    2
  )

summary_table$HeadOn_pct <-
  round(
    100 *
      summary_table$HeadOn /
      summary_table$Total,
    2
  )

summary_table$CellLine <- sub(
  "_file_pattern.*",
  "",
  summary_table$Sample
)


# Plot preparation
plot_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    CellLine = summary_table$CellLine,
    Category = summary_table$Category,
    Orientation = "Co-directional",
    Percent = summary_table$CoDirectional_pct
  ),
  data.frame(
    CellLine = summary_table$CellLine,
    Category = summary_table$Category,
    Orientation = "Head-on",
    Percent = summary_table$HeadOn_pct
  )
)

# Plot
t <- ggplot(plot_df,aes( x = CellLine, y = Percent, fill = Orientation)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Co-directional" = "lightpink2","Head-on" = "cadetblue3")) +
  ylim(0,100) +
  labs(x = "",y = "Percentage of transcripts") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,hjust = 1))

print(t)

# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "/output/plot/path",plot = t,width = 11,height = 4,units = "in")

#############################################################################################################
```
